{"reason": "All 8 failure rows are demand-forecast-error sent to unknown: five show market-mismatch=#t with no other signal, three have forecast-bias=#t but bias 0.065-0.081 below the 0.1 gate. Added a market-signal-mismatch branch mapping to demand-forecast-error and lowered the bias threshold to 0.05; supplier-delay rule untouched, protecting accuracy and recovered amount.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
          (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    ((market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
